method: Frozen dev Pareto champion + 2 mechanism-diverse alternatives with 2x2x2 factorial.

literature_checks.claim: LoopFold trains a predictor and corrector so later recurrent depths of the same token prefix run in parallel stages, reporting 46% lower decoding latency and higher accuracy than a nine-loop vanilla 1.4B model.
literature_checks.transfer_caveat: The predictor, corrector and backbone are jointly trained, and no unchanged Huginn/Ouro checkpoint is evaluated, so it does not show training-free parallel-in-depth works.

literature_checks.claim: SNLP treats layer-by-layer Transformer computation as a nonlinear system solved with parallel Newton-style updates using cheap surrogate Jacobians, reporting up to 2.58x speedup at 0.5B scale.
literature_checks.transfer_caveat: It targets trained ordinary layer-stack Transformers; no quality-preserving speedup is established for frozen Huginn/Ouro.

literature_checks.claim: ParaTAA recasts diffusion sampling as triangular nonlinear equations solved with a training-free accelerated (Anderson-like) fixed-point iteration, cutting inference steps 4-14x, and matching a 100-step DDIM Stable Diffusion sample in 7 steps.
literature_checks.transfer_caveat: Diffusion sampling consistency differs from BF16 causal recurrent KV and long rollouts.

champion.rule: highest dev speedup among depth-parallel (Jacobi-family) arms in any cell with dev accuracy-delta point estimate >= -0.01

metrics.note: truncation baselines (trunc16/trunc3) dominate every depth-parallel arm at matched calls on dev; see cells
